base/pda/skills.png cell 35 holds the original cyborg icon
manual.tionline.ru/implants.htm (2017): Кибернетика доступна с 4 уровня; every implant requires actor level 4
limitations: The 2017 perk table prints ranks at actor levels 1/2/3/4 while the implants page says the perk opens at level 4. User direction: available from level 4; ranks 2-4 at levels 5/6/7 are a local choice so each rank gets its own native tree row.
Implant items, installation, charge and repair are not implemented yet; the perk only opens client slots.
